name: tool-skills
description: Local CLI tool skills for agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Skill routing notes for local CLI tools.
interface.longDescription: A personal local plugin for CLI-first tool workflows. Each bundled skill explains when to use a local command-line tool, how to load version-matched guidance when the CLI provides it, how to verify results, and when to fall back to the host agent's native file and shell tools.
defaultPrompt: Use the right local CLI tool skill for this task.

Use $fast-context for semantic discovery of unknown local code entrypoints unless the request prohibits transmitting repository context to the external service. Load the installed CLI's version-matched Skill before search and verify every returned candidate with local reads and exact rg.
Use $officecli first for reading, inspecting, or extracting Excel files, and for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint workflows that need bounded CLI output.
